measurement_limits: Cloudflare provides authenticated Internet access; inference runs on the Mac and stops if the Mac is asleep or offline.
The UI uses one owner workspace and is not a multi-tenant anonymous public service.
Only fresh synthetic launch conversations were created; no owner stores or sealed banks were read or imported.
An unauthenticated external curl client was verified to reach the Access login gate; a full authenticated external browser conversation was not performed.
Two live prompts prove the runtime path, not model quality; the Arabic-digit arithmetic answer was wrong and is preserved.
No Hugging Face Space or paid hardware was created.
